title: Dynamic Pricing Is Charging You 300% More Right Now
hook: Uber does it. Airlines invented it. Now your grocery store does it too — and the algorithm charged you 300% more today while you had no idea.
angle: Algorithmic dynamic pricing has exploded from airlines to everyday purchases including fast food, groceries, and concert tickets — most people don't know it happens
audience: Anyone who shops online, uses delivery apps, buys groceries, or travels
key_numbers: Dynamic pricing now used by over 87% of major US retailers
